'''Skeletons''', referred to by [[Thok]] as '''Thok will bury him''', '''Bones''' and '''Needs good meal''' are undead enemies encountered during the [[Thok Your Block Off (saga)|Thok Your Block Off]] Fremennik Saga. Those with horns on their helmets attack with magic, and those without use melee.

They initially appear summoned by a [[Forgotten mage]], who is killed by a [[Brute]] shortly afterwards, and later appear in a timed reinforcement room.
